verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that, via MCP, Claude Code can read design docs in Google Drive, update Jira tickets, and pull data from Slack, and can connect to hundreds of external tools. The MCP docs show concrete setup (`claude mcp add --transport http ...`), local stdio servers, and example workflows that use Jira issues and Slack-posted designs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the Jira, Slack, and Google Drive connections work in practice.
